name: BasicJFETModels
_comment_en: JFET small-signal template - Basic level (Analog Insydes BasicJFETSmallSignal, simp==2). Contents: gate-drain capacitance C_gd, gate-source capacitance C_gs, output conductance g_ds (R_ds = 1/GDS) and the transconductance source G_m (gm*V(G,S) current D->S). Gate leak conductances (GGD/GGS) and series ohmic RD/RS are neglected. Value resolution in netlist/Model.py._jfet_ac_param_values: CGD/CGS/GM come straight from the .out OPERATING POINT, GDS -> R_ds = 1/GDS.
